## Wave 7 Summary

Wave 7 executes the two **Stage-2 two-agent parallel cross-axis independent-verify** gates of the Wave-6 STAGE-1 landings, advancing both S100-campaign theorem candidates through the `joint-theorem-promotion.md` 4-stage pathway. Both gates are COMPUTE-class `[VERIFY]` gates whose verdict is a **PASS-AND aggregation** over per-reviewer clause verdicts plus mechanically RE-computed anchor sub-checks — not a bare numerical-threshold comparison. Neither gate derives new physics; each re-examines a **registered substrate-IS structural identity** from first principles via reviewers dispatched WITHOUT prior workshop/synthesis context (`joint-theorem-promotion.md` audit item 4).

- **Item REG #39 — `S101-CONNES-STATEPROJ-STAGE2-VERIFY`**: TWO-agent parallel cross-axis verify of the Wave-6-landed §VII.BM.STATE-PROJ STAGE-1-CANDIDATE (Connes-machinery complex: Theorem A commutative-channel cure dichotomy; Lemma B greybody star metric d(v,g) = λ_g²(τ_fold) exact; generation resolution in the state-pair metric while the operator side stays §VII.BL-obstructed). Axis-A re-derives Theorem A + Lemma B from the registered entry text ALONE (no npz); Axis-B re-verifies the numerical clauses from `s100a_connes_distance_ladder.npz` ALONE — **substrate-input orthogonality SATISFIED BY CONSTRUCTION** (the npz is loaded by exactly one reviewer; Axis-A loads no data file). JOINT clause PASS-AND'd across both verdicts. BINDING spec: `session-100a-connes-machinery-synthesis.md` §V.3 (+ §IV.2–IV.4) + `session-100a-campaign-landscape-synthesis.md` V.15.
- **Item REG #40 — `S101-SCHUR-RIGIDITY-STAGE2-VERIFY`**: TWO-agent parallel cross-verify of the Wave-6-landed Band-Selective Schur Rigidity STAGE-1-CANDIDATE (L0 gauge-free evaluator identity; T1 frozen eigenbundles; T2 Schur-scalar band-matrix + commutant remark; P double protection; U symmetry-undecidability; R release condition; witness table). Both reviewers re-derive L0/T1/T2/P/U from the registered text alone AND independently re-check the witness table from `s100b_nonabelian_metric_fraction.npz` — under this BINDING design the npz is loaded by BOTH reviewers, so the **substrate-input-orthogonality predicate is NOT satisfied; the verdict carries the explicit substrate-input-overlap caveat** per `joint-theorem-promotion.md` §"Substrate-input-orthogonality clause". BINDING spec: `session-100b-berry-geometric-phase-synthesis.md` §V.2 (+ §II.2 clause attribution) + `session-100b-campaign-closeout-synthesis.md` V.9 companion.

**The S99 E1 reviewer-exclusion lesson is load-bearing for this wave** (as it was for S100a W6). The exclusion attaches to the registered entry's STAGE-0 AUTHORSHIP — for gate 1 that is **connes-ncg-theorist** (Stage-0 author of the S-1 synthesis candidate text AND the W2-4 executing agent; §IV.4 of the S-1 synthesis is BINDING); for gate 2 that is **berry-geometric-phase-theorist AND successor berry spawns** (Stage-0 authorship stated at the head of §II.2 of the S-2 synthesis PLUS downstream-inheritance reach: the berry agent-memory file `s100b-band-selective-rigidity.md` already inherits the reading path — existence verified on disk at plan-freeze 2026-06-07, `.claude/agent-memory/berry-geometric-phase-theorist/s100b-band-selective-rigidity.md`, 3,796 bytes). Both gate blocks pin reviewer assignments that EXCLUDE all Stage-0 authors, pin the static `--check-reviewers --strict` audit invocation at the W6→W7 boundary, declare the dispatch-time downstream-inheritance grep, and pre-register the substrate-input-orthogonality status (SATISFIED for gate 1; OVERLAP-CAVEAT for gate 2).

**Reviewer-disjointness design note (planner choice, documented)**: the two gates run in parallel with FOUR DISTINCT primary reviewers (gate 1: van-den-dungen + volovik; gate 2: kaluza-klein + landau). Both primaries-per-gate are drawn from the BINDING-spec suggestion pools (S-1 §IV.4: Axis-A ∈ {vdd, lizzi}, Axis-B ∈ {volovik, landau}; spawn-corpus gate-2 pool: Axis-A ∈ {kk, sp}, Axis-B = landau). Avoiding a double-booked reviewer across two same-wave Stage-2 gates keeps the two PASS-AND verdicts maximally agent-disjoint; fallbacks are pinned per gate and may only fire on an exclusion/inheritance hit.

**Wave classification**: both gates COMPUTE-class `[VERIFY]` per `wave-classification.md` (PASS-AND verdicts + mechanically re-computed anchor sub-checks + dual-SHA closeouts; gate-IDs NOT on the methodology-wave-allowlist; M2 fails for METHODOLOGY-class because a `.py` producing script ships). Dispatch via `/rclab-coordinate` compute-mode: per gate, 2 parallel reviewer dispatches + 1 aggregation closeout by the procedural owner. Natural split per the partition manifest: per-gate (each gate is its own 2-reviewer dispatch pair).

## Wave 7 Decision Point Prerequisites

**HARD run-order dependency on Wave 6** (`session-101-partition.md`: "W6 → W7 (Stage-2 verifies need their Stage-1 landings)"). Neither gate may dispatch before its Stage-1 entry is on disk:

| W7 gate | Required W6 landing (gate ID) | Prerequisite predicate (checked at dispatch) |
|:--------|:------------------------------|:---------------------------------------------|
| `S101-CONNES-STATEPROJ-STAGE2-VERIFY` | `S101-VIIBM-STATEPROJ-LANDING` (W6 item 3) | canonical line `^S101-VIIBM-STATEPROJ-LANDING: PASS` present in `computations/session-101/s101_gate_verdicts.txt` AND the landed §VII.{slot}.STATE-PROJ block present in `sessions/permanent-results-registry.md` |
| `S101-SCHUR-RIGIDITY-STAGE2-VERIFY` | `S101-SCHUR-RIGIDITY-STAGE1-REGISTRATION` (W6 item 6) | canonical line `^S101-SCHUR-RIGIDITY-STAGE1-REGISTRATION: PASS` present in the same verdict file AND the landed §VII.{slot} block present in the registry |

**Conditional closure (pre-registered, per `.claude/rules/mechanical-closure-discipline.md`)**: if a Wave-6 landing gate FAILed, is absent, or landed non-PASS at W7 dispatch time, the corresponding W7 verify gate **honestly closes PRE-REG-INC** — the producing script emits `FAIL -- value='PRE-REG-INC_blocked_by_S101-VIIBM-STATEPROJ-LANDING_<status>'` (resp. `..._blocked_by_S101-SCHUR-RIGIDITY-STAGE1-REGISTRATION_<status>'`) with per-gate-distinct audit_sha256 (pinmap embeds `_gate_id`), updates the WP §-section status/verdict/results/substrate-framing blocks IN THE SAME RUN, and the Stage-2 defers to S102. No reviewer dispatch fires for a blocked gate. The plan anticipates this scenario here, so the closure is NOT post-hoc plan editing (item-1-clean per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md §"When mechanical closure IS acceptable"`).

**Slot-resolution mechanism (plan-text-drift-aware, per `substrate-first-canonical-sourcing.md §(ii.B)`)**: the S-1 synthesis pins the STATE-PROJ landing at "≥ §VII.BM at this writing" and the Schur registration at "next-free §VII slot"; Wave 6 lands SIX entries by the all-header-level next-free-letter scan, so the ACTUAL slot letters are fixed only at W6 runtime (highest pre-W6 slot: §VII.BL, registry grep 2026-06-07). Each W7 producing script therefore **parses the actual §VII slot from its W6 landing gate's verdict-line `value=` field** (the landing gates record the landed slot per registry-write hygiene) and falls back to a registry header grep for `STATE-PROJ` / the Schur title if the value-field parse fails. Any drift from the expected §VII.BM.STATE-PROJ is documented in the W7 verdict `value=` field, not silently absorbed.

**Static reviewer-exclusion leg CANNOT be pre-cleared at plan-freeze** (unlike the S100a W6 precedent): the target entries do not exist in the registry until Wave 6 lands. Verified live at plan-freeze 2026-06-07: `_joint_theorem_independent_verify_audit.py --self-test` → `self_test: PASS (positive=EXCLUSION-FAIL, negative=EXCLUSION-PASS, authors_matched=True)`; pre-landing demonstration `--check-reviewers VII.BM.STATE-PROJ --reviewers van-den-dungen-bridge-theorist,volovik-superfluid-universe-theorist` → `INFO_SLOT_NOT_FOUND` (expected pre-W6 behavior; flag names `--check-reviewers`, `--reviewers`, `--strict`, `--self-test` all confirmed present in the script's argparse, grep 2026-06-07). The static leg is therefore a **MANDATORY W6→W7 boundary check**: the dispatching orchestrator runs the pinned invocation (per-gate, see machinery_pin_map) AFTER the W6 landing and BEFORE any reviewer dispatch; `EXCLUSION-FAIL` (exit 1 under `--strict`) → substitute the pinned fallback reviewer and re-run to `EXCLUSION-PASS`.

**Wave-1 LC-lineage conditional (gate 2 only)**: the Schur candidate's witness numbers are LC-lineage-conditional (the registered text carries the caveat verbatim). At W7 dispatch, check `^S101-TAU0-OPERATOR-CANONICITY:` in the verdict file: if its L4 caveat-lift leg has executed (gate landed with the L4 lift attested), reviewers cite witness values clean; otherwise the gate 2 verdict + WP section carry the A19 UNTRUSTED-UPSTREAM extra-row per the session cross-wave pin 1. The conditional toggles ONLY the citation tag — the clause-(g) re-verification is an internal-consistency check against the PINNED npz and is lineage-independent (the algebra clauses (a)–(f) are operator-independent by the candidate's own split).

substitution_chain:

PASS_meaning: >
  Stage-2 PASS-AND: both cross-reviewers independently PASS all own-axis clauses AND the JOINT clause
  (logical AND), and every mechanical anchor sub-check reproduces within its pinned tolerance. The
  registered SVII.{slot}.STATE-PROJ intra-pillar theorem complex survives structurally-independent
  two-agent cross-axis verify; route STAGE-1-CANDIDATE -> STAGE-3-PERMANENT (orchestrator-direct tag
  edit at session-end synthesis, Stage-3-CLASS tag JOINT-CROSS-AXIS-STAGE-2-PASS-AND). Solution-space:
  the framework's first regulator-invariant, theorem-backed metric realization of generation
  resolution is confirmed at the permanent layer — resolution in the algebra-DEPENDENT state-pair
  functional, operator side SVII.BL-obstructed, the algebra-axis orthogonality concretized.
FAIL_meaning: >
  At least one reviewer returns FAIL on at least one clause, OR an anchor sub-check exceeds its pinned
  tolerance. Stage-2 -> 3 promotion BLOCKED; the entry holds STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; the FAILing clause(s)
  route to S102 remediation (4-field CF naming the clause). Solution-space: the named clause is the
  structural weak point — e.g. an A1 FAIL would re-open the two-sided CLASS-gamma dichotomy (the
  S87/S88 regulator wall's cure), a B1/anchor FAIL would mean the registered ladder numbers do not
  re-derive from their own pinned npz (registration transcription defect, routed as registry-hygiene
  remediation rather than physics retraction), a J1 FAIL would challenge the Corner-IV/Corner-I
  orthogonal-companion reading itself.
INFO_meaning: >
  No clause FAIL and anchors within tolerance, but at least one clause returns INFO
  (Stage-2-INFO-deferred). The entry holds STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; the INFO clause is documented and the
  Stage-2 re-attempt (if warranted) is a new S102 gate. Plausible INFO sources: the Lemma-B
  non-scalar-coupling boundary clause (its strictness witness is queued as the W2 forward gate
  S101-STAR-METRIC-BLOCK-LEMMA, so a reviewer may INFO-defer boundary sharpness while PASSing the
  closed forms); an A3 hygiene INFO on annotation scope. PRE-REG-INC closure (W6 landing absent/FAIL)
  is emitted as FAIL with the value-string prefix PRE-REG-INC_blocked_by_... per
  mechanical-closure-discipline.md — structurally untestable this session, deferred to S102.

# ---- Effort + framing ----
effort:
  files_created:
    - "computations/session-101/s101_connes_stateproj_stage2_verify.py"
    - "computations/session-101/s101_connes_stateproj_stage2_verify.npz"
    - "computations/session-101/s101_connes_stateproj_stage2_verify.png"
    - "sessions/session-101/session-101-w7-workingpaper.md (§W7-1 section)"
  estimated_time: "3-4 h wall (2 parallel reviewer dispatches, ~1 agent-session each per the BINDING spec, + 1 aggregation closeout)"

substrate_framing: |
  GEOMETRIC. The verify target is a substrate-IS structural identity at the single-tau-slice level
  (Level 1 per phononic-framing.md): on the spectral triple (A_K, H_K, D_K(tau_fold)), the per-sector
  D_K^2 cache floors omega_g = lambda_g^2(tau_fold) ARE the greybody couplings of the channel star

  -> greybody star couplings -> state-pair distance ladder -> the generation hierarchy as floor

# (7) substitution_chain — conjunction-logic chain (no physics sign/direction claim; [VERIFY] aggregation)
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Definition 1: V_A(c) = Axis-A (kaluza-klein-theorist) verdict on clause c in {a,b,c,d,e,f,g}.
    Definition 2: V_B(c) = Axis-B (landau-condensed-matter-theorist) verdict on clause c in {a,b,c,d,e,f,g}.
    Definition 3: W = the set of mechanical witness re-checks (witness_recheck_pins rows g1/g2/g3 + scalar-consistency rows), each a boolean within-pin flag re-computed by the aggregation script from the pinned npz.
    Definition 4: BINDING criterion (S-2 §V.2 / closeout V.9 companion): PASS iff both reviewers independently PASS every clause (a)-(g), with joint clauses PASS-AND'd.
    Substitute (composite): composite = [AND_{c in {a..g}} (V_A(c)=PASS AND V_B(c)=PASS)] AND [AND_{w in W} w=True].
    Simplify: the per-clause conjunct (V_A(c)=PASS AND V_B(c)=PASS) for ALL c is the all-clauses-dual-verified form; for any clause subset J tagged JOINT in the landed entry, the JOINT requirement AND_{j in J}(V_A(j)=PASS AND V_B(j)=PASS) is a sub-conjunction of the same form — hence automatically satisfied; the criterion is route-invariant.
    Canonical form: composite in {PASS, FAIL, INFO} per operator.form (FAIL on any clause-FAIL or witness-pin violation; INFO on any clause-INFO absent FAIL).
    Direction: dual-verification of every clause is strictly stronger than single-axis ownership partitioning — a clause passing in only ONE reviewer does NOT satisfy the gate (the BINDING criterion's structural-independence guarantee; OR is FORBIDDEN).
    Conclusion: composite=PASS routes the Schur-rigidity STAGE-1-CANDIDATE to STAGE-3-PERMANENT (orchestrator-direct tag edit at session-end synthesis, Stage-3-CLASS tag JOINT-CROSS-AXIS-STAGE-2-PASS-AND, carrying the OVERLAP-CAVEAT tag and, if applicable, the A19 lineage extra-row); composite in {FAIL, INFO} holds STAGE-1 (FAIL clauses route to S102 remediation; INFO clauses log Stage-2-INFO-deferred).

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  Stage-2 PASS-AND under the BINDING all-clauses-dual-verified criterion: both cross-reviewers
  independently PASS every clause (a)-(g), any JOINT-tagged clauses PASS-AND'd within the same
  conjunction, and every mechanical witness re-check reproduces within its pinned tolerance. The
  registered Band-Selective Schur Rigidity theorem survives structurally-independent two-agent
  cross-verify; route STAGE-1-CANDIDATE -> STAGE-3-PERMANENT (orchestrator-direct tag edit at
  session-end synthesis, Stage-3-CLASS tag JOINT-CROSS-AXIS-STAGE-2-PASS-AND), with the
  substrate-input-OVERLAP-CAVEAT carried explicitly (the PASS-AND establishes output-type
  independence on the shared npz, per the pre-registered declaration). Solution-space: the
  symmetry-undecidability no-go is confirmed at the permanent layer — G-invariant functionals on
  G-invariant bases CANNOT discriminate Abelian vs non-Abelian band structure; the W5
  isotropy-breaking discriminator is the licensed (and only) release route.
FAIL_meaning: >
  At least one reviewer returns FAIL on at least one clause, OR a witness re-check violates its pin.
  Stage-2 -> 3 promotion BLOCKED; the entry holds STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; the FAILing clause(s) route to
  S102 remediation (4-field CF naming the clause). Solution-space: a FAIL on (a)-(e) would locate a
  defect in the Schur/equivariance derivation chain itself (high-information: the same skeleton
  underwrites the L0-L7 rigidity record); a FAIL on (g) means the registered witness table does not
  re-derive from its own pinned npz (registration-transcription defect, routed as registry-hygiene
  remediation rather than physics retraction); a FAIL on (f) would un-license the W5 discriminator's
  release logic and re-scope S101-B2-ISOTROPY-BREAKING's interpretation.
INFO_meaning: >
  No clause FAIL and witness pins hold, but at least one clause returns INFO
  (Stage-2-INFO-deferred). The entry holds STAGE-1-CANDIDATE. Plausible INFO sources: the clause-(c)
  commutant remark (real/quaternionic-type determination left open by the entry, honestly); a
  clause-(g) citation INFO under an undischarged LC-lineage caveat (internal consistency PASSes, the
  citation tag stays conditional); a clause-(f) genericity grading. PRE-REG-INC closure (W6
  registration absent/FAIL) is emitted as FAIL with the value-string prefix PRE-REG-INC_blocked_by_...
  per mechanical-closure-discipline.md — structurally untestable this session, deferred to S102.

# ---- Effort + framing ----
effort:
  files_created:
    - "computations/session-101/s101_schur_rigidity_stage2_verify.py"
    - "computations/session-101/s101_schur_rigidity_stage2_verify.npz"
    - "computations/session-101/s101_schur_rigidity_stage2_verify.png"
    - "sessions/session-101/session-101-w7-workingpaper.md (§W7-2 section)"
  estimated_time: "2-3 h wall (2 parallel reviewer dispatches + 1 aggregation closeout; <= half a session combined per the BINDING spec)"

substrate_framing: |
  GEOMETRIC, at the Level-2 moduli-deformation substrate-IS layer (phononic-framing.md): the (tau,mu)
  base is the substrate's OWN Jensen TT-deformation manifold, not a coordinate container — the
  registered theorem is a statement about how the fabric's band geometry behaves ON its own moduli
  manifold. The substrate IS the (0,0) Peter-Weyl singlet spinor fiber C^16 with its fixed U(2)
  isotropy representation (fixed because Peter-Weyl block structure is metric-independent — S22b,
  PROVEN); the bands ARE eigenbundles of D_K(tau,mu) restricted to that fiber. The direction of
  explanation flows substrate -> emergent: D_K(tau,mu) eigenbundles -> gauge-free projector QGT ->
  Schur-forced scalarity of every G-invariant band-matrix -> the symmetry-undecidability no-go
  (no G-invariant functional can decide Abelian vs non-Abelian band structure) -> the
  isotropy-breaking release condition that licenses the W5 discriminator. Container-thinking
  inversions ("the bands live in a parameter space we scan from outside", "the QGT measures geometry
  IN the moduli container") are FORBIDDEN per phononic-framing.md §"IS Space, Not IN Space" — the
  rigidity is the fabric's own representation-theoretic lock, and the W6-2 FAIL(a) record this
  candidate reframes is the substrate telling us the invariant base CANNOT see the difference
  (Corollary U), not that the difference is absent. This Stage-2 gate re-examines the registered
  identity from first principles via two reviewers who never saw the authoring synthesis; it adds no
  new physics, it audits whether the registered no-go and its witness table withstand
